requirements.text: Professional software development experience, with significant ownership of user-facing products or features.
Strong experience building applications across multiple parts of the stack, such as mobile or web clients, backend services, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
A track record of taking ambiguous product ideas through technical design, implementation, launch, and iteration.
Strong product judgment and attention to interaction quality, usability, performance, and craft.
Experience building polished frontend experiences using a modern mobile or web framework.
Experience designing and operating backend services, APIs, and data models in production.
Comfort moving through the stack to solve the most important product or user problem.
Strong understanding of software architecture, testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability.
Experience collaborating closely with product, design, backend, data, or AI teams.
An understanding that reliability, latency, and data integrity are fundamental parts of the user experience.
An ownership mindset and bias for action. You identify important problems, create clarity, and drive work through completion.
Experience building AI-native, conversational, agentic, or real-time product experiences.
Experience with Flutter and Dart or another cross-platform mobile framework.
Experience building modern web applications with JavaScript or TypeScript.
Experience integrating large language models, transcription systems, or other machine-learning services into production products.
Experience with audio or video capture, streaming, transcription, or long-running media workflows.
Experience with offline-first applications, background sync, resilient local persistence, or conflict handling.
Experience designing event-driven systems, asynchronous workflows, or real-time data pipelines.
Familiarity with product analytics, experimentation, and measuring feature adoption or usability.
Experience with performance optimization, observability, CI/CD, and release automation.
Native iOS or Android experience when platform-specific capabilities are needed.
Exposure to healthcare, HIPAA, SOC 2, privacy, security, or other regulated environments.
Experience with Chrome extensions or workflows that span mobile, browser, and web applications.
